identity_and_theme.persona: E1 Creative Designer - High-Performance Dark Trading Terminal Strategy
aesthetic_principles: Zero Visual Slop - Sharp 1px Micro Borders (#1E2638)
Multi-Color Market Signal Hierarchy (Green = Buying/Bullish, Red = Selling/Bearish, Cyan = Neutral/Info, Amber = Important/Warning, Violet = Advanced Analytics)
Dense, Precision-Aligned Data Layouts for Desktop-First Execution with dedicated mobile panel switcher

typography.file_extension_note: Target codebase uses .js / .jsx React standard. Do not write .tsx type annotations.

landing_page.layout: High-impact narrative layout with Lenis smooth scroll, hero order-flow preview, grid-based feature highlights, interactive footprint interactive canvas widget, pricing cards, and FAQ.
landing_page.spacing: Generous section padding py-20 lg:py-28, gap-8 to gap-12 between content blocks.

trading_terminal.desktop: 4-Region Grid: TopBar (Height 48px), Left Toolbar (Width 48px), Center Footprint/Volume Profile Canvas + Bottom Analytics Tabs, Right Side DOM/OrderBook Panel & Live Tape.
trading_terminal.mobile: Single Column with Sticky Bottom Navigation Switcher [CHART | DOM | TAPE | SIGNALS | ANALYTICS] ensuring zero squeezed controls.

admin_dashboard.grid: High Density Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4) featuring WebSocket Health, Data Feeds Status, Active Subscriptions, System Settings, and User Management.

user_dashboard.grid: 3-Column Bento Grid featuring My Saved Layouts, Active Alerts, Subscription Tier, API Key Management, and Recent Signals.

canvas_and_rendering.footprint_chart: Rendered using HTML5 Canvas / WebGL context for 60FPS tick-level rendering. Must depict candle outline, stacked imbalance highlights (#FF007A), Point of Control (POC #FFD700), VWAP cyan line, and bid-ask matrix inside each candle body.
canvas_and_rendering.volume_profile: Adjacent horizontal bar chart showing net volume & delta per price level with High Volume Nodes (HVN) and Low Volume Nodes (LVN).

hero_backgrounds.description: Professional multi-monitor trading desk setup with financial charts
Mechanical keyboard and analytics display showing stock market graphs

testing_and_accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, exchange toggles, chart tabs, DOM buttons) MUST include a kebab-case data-testid attribute. E.g., data-testid='exchange-selector-binance', data-testid='order-flow-tab-signals', data-testid='terminal-open-button'.
testing_and_accessibility.accessibility: High contrast WCAG AA compliant colors for dark theme. Full keyboard shortcuts support for chart navigation (Zoom +/- , Reset view, Switch tab).

instructions_to_main_agent.1: Use .js / .jsx React files with Tailwind CSS classes.
instructions_to_main_agent.2: Never use fully transparent backgrounds for headers or overlays. Always use high-contrast glassmorphic backgrounds (rgba(13, 16, 26, 0.85) with backdrop-blur-md).
instructions_to_main_agent.3: Render tick tape and DOM panel with continuous simulated WebSocket micro-animations for real-time market action feel.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: Ensure signal cards indicate confidence levels explicitly: Strong (#00E676), Moderate (#00F0FF), Weak (#FFB800), Neutral (#64748B) without implying financial certainty.
instructions_to_main_agent.5: Implement Sonner toasts for connection status, price alert triggers, and backtest results.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic admin dashboard aesthetics. Emulate high-end professional order flow software like DepthTerm, VolFix, and Bookmap.
Ensure dark colors look crisp with sharp 1px borders (#1E2638) and subtle dark shadows.
Do NOT apply universal transitions like transition: all. Use specific property transitions.
Do NOT center align the app root container text.
Do NOT use AI assistant emojis (🤖, 🧠, 💡) for icons. Use lucide-react or phosphor icons.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid attributes.
